project_type: Kotlin/Java Spring Boot + Vert.x web server (reader book service)
build_system: Gradle with build.gradle.kts (full build) and cli.gradle (headless CLI build). The cli.gradle excludes ReaderUIApplication.kt for Docker builds.
test_framework: Spring Boot test starter (spring-boot-starter-test), but no test files currently exist in the project
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/reader-dev && ./gradlew -b cli.gradle assemble --info (no unit tests exist; compilation is the primary validation)
verification_instructions: 1. Run ./gradlew -b cli.gradle assemble --info to verify compilation. 2. Verify no missing imports or type errors. 3. For Docker builds: docker build -f Dockerfile.source -t reader:test .
setup_instructions: The project uses Gradle wrapper. Java 8 target. Run ./gradlew -b cli.gradle assemble to build the headless jar.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Java 8 compatibility required (sourceCompatibility = 1.8). Kotlin 1.5.21. Spring Boot 2.1.6.RELEASE. Vert.x 3.8.1 (upgrading to 3.8.5).
contribution_requirements: Keep userLimit at 50 (dev's higher limit). Do NOT remove ReaderUIApplication.kt (JavaFX GUI). cli.gradle removes it at build time for Docker.
key_patterns: Controllers extend BaseController(coroutineContext). Storage uses JSON files via getStorage/saveStorage utility functions in VertExt.kt. Routes registered in YueduApi.initRouter(). Entities are data classes in io.legado.app.data.entities. AppConfig uses Spring @ConfigurationProperties. workDir/storagePath configured in application.yml.
directory_structure: src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/ - main application code (config, entity, utils, api controllers, verticle, init). src/main/java/io/legado/app/ - ported legado library (model, data entities, help, utils, constants). src/main/resources/ - Spring config, static resources. web/ - Vue frontend source. src/lib/ - bundled JARs (rhino, xmlpull).
